en: A sepia-toned postcard showing large stone ruins in the foreground, likely the remains of a medieval fortress wall or tower with an arched opening. Behind the ruins is a small town with wooden houses and a prominent church featuring two tall spires dominating the skyline. The image has a wide border, and the bottom-left corner bears a printed caption with the place name.
